RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

A panel’s demographic composition alone is not evidence of unlawful bias. Academic hiring committees frequently weigh specific departmental needs—such as practical industry background, subfield alignment, teaching demonstrations, and interview rapport—over raw publication counts.

Accusing a committee of sex discrimination without documented, concrete proof will severely harm your professional reputation and close doors across the discipline. Furthermore, a two-week silence on feedback is standard bureaucratic delay, not evidence of bad faith. 

Do not mention gender. Instead, send a polite, professional follow-up reiterating your interest and asking for constructive feedback on how you can strengthen future applications. Focus entirely on qualification fit and institutional needs.
